snippet.title: FriendOS - Demo RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
TRY THE DEMO / WISHLIST - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4531070/FriendOS_Demo/
join the discord! - https://discord.com/invite/eCjYgnZdzX

hey !!! happy to announce that the FriendOS Demo is finally out and ready for you to give a shot!!! i've been hard at work composing and making sound effects for a while now! (including this trailer's music!!) if you play let me know what you think of all the tracks in the game so far!! hope to upload a couple of em here soon! and if you try the demo look out for bobo .........
